title: Annual Spend Commitments and the Move-Up Entry Gate
content:
A customer whose Contract Pricing Agreement carries a large annual spend commitment faces a lower entry gate when it asks to move one of its Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts up a level.

**Clause.** The next level's entry gate is applied at a share set by the customer's active Contract Pricing Agreement: at 88 percent where its annual spend commitment is at least 150000.00, at 94 percent where it is at least 60000.00 and less than 150000.00, and in full otherwise.

| Annual spend commitment on the active agreement (USD) | Share of the next level's entry gate applied |
|---|---|
| 150000.00 or more | 88 percent |
| at least 60000.00, less than 150000.00 | 94 percent |
| less than 60000.00, no commitment, or no active agreement | in full |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical commitments):** 150000.00 gives 88 percent and 149999.99 gives 94 percent; 60000.00 gives 94 percent and 59999.99 applies the gate in full.

*Hypothetical figure:* a next-level entry gate of 10000.00 applied at 94 percent is 9400.00.

The commitment is read from the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement whose status is active.
